value.rationale: The result answers a concrete open all-group endemic-existence conjecture in its native model. It isolates a nontrivial endogenous network-reducibility mechanism by which a supercritical disease-free state coexists with a stable partially endemic alternative, even for C2 monotone behaviors and strictly positive epidemiological rates; a general positive-creation theorem identifies a scientifically natural sufficient condition for avoiding that failure. This is not a textbook special case or arbitrary numeric slice.
